parts:
Hi all,

We will have our first weekly work session of the year tomorrow, 10-12 in Wickson 2120J (up the central stairs, take a right into the first hallway, and it's the first door on your left). No talk this week, so bring your laptops, and we'll sit around and code, discuss R-related topics, and answer each other's questions. Plus, cookies.

See you tomorrow,

Michael
